text:
Jack Eichel is the engine in Vegas, and he is running hot. He has 33 points in 26 games, a five-game point streak, and the local Eichel Tracker is "inching closer to the century mark." Our season-end range has him between 89 and 117 points.

The assists are the bedrock. Twenty-two of his points are helpers, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 98th percentile among forwards for primary shot assists last season, with carry-ins on 58% of his zone entries. His skating backs up the eye test: 127 bursts over 20 mph this season, at the very top of the league. Evolving-Hockey had him sixth among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season.

The goals are where we'd temper things. Eleven goals on eight expected, shooting 15% against 10% last season, and Vegas has scored six more goals than expected with him on the ice. We flag him as due to cool on the finishing. The Athletic's Jesse Granger, after a power-play goal against Edmonton, called his release "absurd," and it has been. The playmaking, at 3.7 points per 60, is the sturdier part.
headline: Jack Eichel, chasing the century mark
